race.title: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap
race.verdict: Having dropped in the weights, GAVOO has found his level and on the back of a very encouraging third over C&D, he looks too well weighted to ignore. Art Gallery was behind the selection that day but is entitled to step up on that stable debut, with Leveraging also considered. GAVOO (IRE) ART GALLERY (IRE) LEVERAGING (IRE)
